meta.title: NCPOR Digital Knowledge Platform
meta.dataStatus: Mixed catalogue: institutional context plus clearly marked illustrative demo records
meta.notice: Demo measurements, publications and researcher profiles are fictional-but-realistic and are not official NCPOR records.

datasets.title: Arctic black carbon observations — demonstration series
datasets.summary: A compact teaching dataset showing monthly black-carbon concentration, wind speed and air temperature near a demonstration Arctic station.
datasets.plainLanguage: Black carbon is made of tiny light-absorbing particles. This sample series helps demonstrate how researchers compare particle levels with weather through time.
datasets.dataStatus: Illustrative sample values — not an official observation record
datasets.citation: NCPOR Digital Knowledge Platform demo team (2026). Arctic black carbon observations — demonstration series.

datasets.title: Maitri summer weather observations
datasets.summary: A teaching-ready subset of air temperature, pressure and wind observations connected to the existing Maitri expedition story.
datasets.plainLanguage: A small weather table for learning how Antarctic conditions change across several observation windows.
datasets.dataStatus: Illustrative sample values — linked to the existing fictional expedition bundle
datasets.citation: Polar Commons demo team (2026). Maitri summer weather observations.

datasets.title: Bharati coastal ocean profile — demonstration dataset
datasets.summary: A small depth profile for exploring temperature and salinity relationships in a polar coastal setting.
datasets.plainLanguage: This sample shows how seawater temperature and salt content can be compared at increasing depth.
datasets.dataStatus: Illustrative sample values — not an official observation record
datasets.citation: NCPOR Digital Knowledge Platform demo team (2026). Bharati coastal ocean profile.

publications.title: Interpreting seasonal black-carbon signals in the Arctic: a demonstration brief
publications.summary: A fictional methods brief created to demonstrate evidence-linked publication discovery and cautious trend interpretation.
publications.abstract: The brief compares a compact illustrative black-carbon series with wind and temperature. It demonstrates correlation-oriented exploration but does not make a scientific finding.
publications.dataStatus: Illustrative publication — not peer reviewed and not an official NCPOR output
publications.citation: Menon, I. & Kapoor, N. (2024). Interpreting seasonal black-carbon signals in the Arctic: a demonstration brief.

publications.title: Weather context for a connected Maitri field story
publications.summary: A demonstration note connecting weather observations, field activities and the existing expedition narrative.
publications.abstract: This fictional note illustrates how a knowledge graph can connect an expedition, place, dataset and explanatory story.
publications.dataStatus: Illustrative publication — not peer reviewed and not an official NCPOR output
publications.citation: Rao, A. (2024). Weather context for a connected Maitri field story.
